meta.title: About TiniLearners | Playful learning for ages 3–7
meta.description: Why TiniLearners makes short, playful learning books and printables for children from preschool to 1st grade, and how every page is designed.

heading: Learning that fits in 15 minutes
intro: TiniLearners makes learning books and printable PDFs for children from preschool to 1st grade. Each page is a short, complete activity you can do together at the kitchen table, then put away on a win.

principles.name: Short pages that end on a win
principles.body: Each activity takes a few minutes and has a clear finish, so practice stops while it’s still fun.

principles.name: A routine children can predict
principles.body: Pages follow the same pattern, so little learners know what comes next and can do more on their own.

principles.name: Paper first
principles.body: Tracing, cutting and coloring with real crayons builds the hand strength and control children need for writing.

principles.name: Skills teachers look for
principles.body: Letters, sounds, counting and pencil control: the building blocks children use when they start school.

contactBody: Questions about a book, an order or the Club? Email us and a real person will reply.
audience: Parents and caregivers of children from preschool to 1st grade, roughly ages 3 to 7.
Families who want a little learning at home without more screen time. Every page works on paper with crayons and a pencil.
Busy evenings and slow weekends alike. Each activity is complete in a few minutes, so you can stop whenever your learner is ready.
